definition: Direct browser opening and reading of one or more source body paragraphs on each named ICRSP article, distinct from a complete all-author literary/textual collation.
riskPolicy: Historical host presentations and liturgical author commentary are primary witnesses to their published statements but not independently verified historical fact, 1962 rubric, universal feast, translation rights, or app content absence.

rows.sourceBlockLocator: Introduction – Le Mystère de la Rédemption / 1. — Exposé dogmatique
rows.observedTextualTopic: The source introduces Septuagesima as the lead-in to the Paschal cycle and proposes OT prefigurative themes for Lent.
rows.releaseGate: Do not import general biblical typology into the Historia Salutis narration or claim each cited figure is an explicit NT fulfilment.

rows.observedTextualTopic: Source presents April 25 Major Litanies, abstinence versus fasting, penitential procession with Paschal elements, and Latin procession rubric; its Gregory 589 plague narrative needs separate historical-origin adjudication.
rows.releaseGate: Verify precise 1962 Roman Ritual/Missal procession text and actor, calendar, April 25 transfer conditions and historic Major/Lesser Litanies origin. Do not transfer priest posture to Mass reader.

rows.observedTextualTopic: The source discusses September Ember Days and Guéranger associates seasonal fasting with the fasts in Zechariah, distinguishing annual ecclesiastical observance from the narrative Paschal cycle.
rows.releaseGate: Check 1962 Ember Day computation and liturgical week independently; no automatic Jewish-origin historical claim or calendar date change.

rows.sourceTitle: St Athanase, Evêque, Confesseur et Docteur
rows.observedTextualTopic: The source records Athanasius's death at Alexandria on 2 May 373 and gives stages of feast reception and liturgical rank through the sixteenth century.
rows.releaseGate: Verify the existing 1962 feast identity and saint record; historical rank chronology is not 1962 rank; modern text reproduction not approved.

rows.observedTextualTopic: The source distinguishes Polycarp's ancient martyrdom commemoration from Roman January 26 feast and quotes the elderly martyr's refusal to renounce Christ.
rows.releaseGate: Check precise ancient Martyrdom of Polycarp date and translation, ancient chronicling and 1962 Roman observance; do not assert 23 Feb 156 exact history independently.

rows.sourceTitle: St Ignace d’Antioche, évêque et martyr
rows.observedTextualTopic: The source juxtaposes different Eastern and Western observance dates and recounts a traditional infancy association from a later narrative.
rows.releaseGate: Do not assert the saint was the child in the Gospel as historical fact; verify Eastern/Western calendars and original passion accounts, 1962 Roman feast.

rows.sourceTitle: Dédicace de l’Archibasilique du Très Saint Sauveur
rows.observedTextualTopic: The source treats November 9 as the dedication of Rome's cathedral, notes historic rank changes and distinguishes the Lateran from Peter-and-Paul basilica commemorations.
rows.releaseGate: Verify cathedral identity in canonical church/saints-calendar owner and 1962 rank; distinguish Lateran feast Nov9 from Nov18 other-basilica dedication and historical printed provenance.

rows.sourceBlockLocator: Présentation / Liste des Docteurs de l’Église
rows.observedTextualTopic: The source defines the Church Doctor designation and lists Doctors; it is explanatory reference prose rather than evidence for a new Common's liturgical text.
rows.releaseGate: The list and count of Doctors can change; verify against currently authoritative ecclesiastical sources before showing and avoid treating a current list as frozen 1962 rubrics.

rows.observedTextualTopic: The source identifies a June 15 translation observance distinct from a September 4 saint's feast and says the local translation formulary contains three proper collects and a different short Gospel.
rows.releaseGate: Verify Toul/local jurisdiction, exact year and missal edition, and saint ID; do not promote June 15 to universal 1962 observance or mutate existing Mass form slots.

rows.sourceBlockLocator: Présentation / Bhx Cardinal Schuster, Liber Sacramentorum : la bénédiction nuptiale
rows.observedTextualTopic: The source distinguishes Roman wedding consent before Mass from variant local customs and separately explains the Nuptial Blessing in an attributed Schuster passage.
rows.releaseGate: Verify exact 1962 nuptial rubrics, ritual jurisdiction/local custom and the Schuster edition; do not infer universal in-Mass consent-placement or reader gesture from this page.

rows.sourceTitle: Prudence, Passion des Apôtres Pierre et Paul
rows.observedTextualTopic: The source explicitly identifies Prudentius's late-fourth/early-fifth-century Peristephanon as poetry on the martyrs alongside later Guéranger commentary on Peter.
rows.releaseGate: Locate the relevant exact original Latin poem/line reference before authentic excerpt display; do not import an Office module or present Guéranger's wording as Prudentius.
